practices.title: Belly Breathing
practices.purpose: Promotes diaphragmatic recruitment, reduces chest/accessory muscle strain, and enhances basal lung ventilation.
practices.instruction: Sit or lie comfortably with one hand on your chest and the other on your belly. Inhale slowly through your nose for 3 seconds, letting your stomach rise against your hand while keeping your chest still. Exhale gently through your mouth for 3 seconds as your stomach falls. Perform 10 cycles (~2 minutes).

practices.title: Core Brace
practices.purpose: Integrates diaphragmatic respiration with intra-abdominal pressure control to stabilize the lumbo-pelvic complex during breath cycles.
practices.instruction: Inhale through your nose for 3 seconds, allowing your abdomen to expand. Hold your breath for 2 seconds while lightly tightening your abdominal muscles (like bracing for a soft touch). Slowly exhale through your mouth for 3 seconds while maintaining that gentle core tension. Perform 8 to 10 cycles (~2 minutes).

practices.title: Breath_L1_L2
practices.purpose: Leverages an extended expiratory phase to stimulate vagal nerve tone, promoting parasympathetic relaxation and lowering heart rate.
practices.instruction: Inhale smoothly through your nose for 3 seconds without holding at the top. Gently blow out through your mouth for a long, slow 5-second exhale to fully release tension. Perform 8 to 10 cycles (~2 minutes).

practices.title: Breath_L3_Pause
practices.purpose: Increases end-inspiratory hold time to improve alveolar gas exchange, optimize arterial oxygenation, and enhance lung compliance.
practices.instruction: Take a deep breath in through your nose over 4 seconds. Pause and hold your breath in steady stillness for 2 seconds. Slowly exhale through your mouth over 6 seconds until your lungs feel empty. Perform 6 to 8 cycles (~2 minutes).

practices.title: Breath_L4_8s
practices.focus: Peak lung exchange & deep core recoil
practices.purpose: Uses pursed-lip breathing to create positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP), preventing small airway collapse while maximizing elastic core recoil.
practices.instruction: Inhale deeply through your nose for 4 seconds. Pucker your lips like blowing out a candle, then slowly release your breath through pursed lips for a full 8 seconds while feeling your deep core gently pull inward. Perform 5 to 6 cycles (~2 minutes).

safety_text.lightheadedness_valve: If you feel lightheaded, breathless, or dizzy at any point, immediately stop counting and return to your normal, comfortable breathing pattern.
safety_text.orthostatic_warning: When moving between lying down, seated, or standing positions, pause for 10-15 seconds while seated. If dizziness occurs, remain seated until fully recovered.
safety_text.chair_standard: Use a sturdy, non-wheeled chair placed on a non-slip surface.
